Question: What do you like to do when you are feeling low?
Answer: I plan. I set higher targets for myself. We tend to feel low when things don't go our way. Failures and disappointments are part of life and there should be a way to deal with it. One need break and recreation time to remain but I know when I deserve that break and when I don't. I can't chill watching a movie when I know I haven't completed my targets for the week. See, I can watch a movie, go for an outing, do an episode of emotional eating. There are innumerable ways, but I believe this will distract me for a while but at the of the day, I will have to face the reality and deal with it. There can be any sort of reason for me feeling low. Personal, emotional, academical or whatever. These failures and disappointment ignites something inside and I become more goal oriented. I find my motivation in my failures. I find motivation in rejections. I find motivation in humiliation. I find motivation in disappointments. I find motivation in awkwardness. I find motivation in silence. Negatives get inside me and push me to work harder than before. Constant self doubt and fear of failure keeps me going. Your past situation should never be a deciding factor for your tomorrow. Constantly work on changing your present, so that your tomorrow can be better. If you get comfortable in your present circumstances you will never be able to grow. There is always something inside me that wants change in my current situation and because I want that change, I consciously work for it. Rabiya

Question: Do marks really matter in life?
Answer: Yes, marks matter. At some point of time marks matter and after some time it doesn't. Your 10th grade marks will ‘help you’ to decide which stream you want to choose next. Your 12th grade marks will decide your college. Your graduation marks will decide your post graduation or your job or whatever. So, what I am trying to say is ‘marks' do matter. It's just the matter of time. Once you enter college, your 10th grade marks won't matter anymore. Once you complete your graduation, your 12th grade marks won't matter anymore. Image source - Google Now, marks matter in Life? Overall speaking about Life, for some it may matter and for some it may not. There are extremely successful people out there who were not good at academics and also there are people who were extremely good at academics but are not successful. People who want to add value to their life, will add it anyway whether with good marks or bad marks. ~Marks define a phase of your life, it does not define your life.

Question: What hurts you the most?
Answer: I have been staying up all night these days so that I don't end up creating the huge backlog as it's Ramadan and I fast during the day. I somehow manage to study for 1–2 hours during the day but that isn't enough. Today was kind of gloomy for me. I overslept and I was upset. I was feeling overwhelmed. I everyday attend 9–10 hours of online classes for my CA Inter. Let alone the self study time. So, generally my study time is around 12–13 hours but still I am not confident about it. Plus I have to study for my university exams which is due in the next week. Yesterday, I went to college as well and I saw my classmates who were nicely enjoying college life. They would just study before exams and get away with it. People were having fun, bunking lectures to watch movies and attending parties and all those gimmick. After seeing all these - I was feeling miserable for myself. I was thinking - Why I have to study for whole year while my classmates just study during the exams ? I literally have no time even on Sundays for anything and even I do something for my pleasure, I feel guilty. All of these thoughts got into my head and I was pretty envious of my other batch mates. I got home and just slept so that I can just get away with my thoughts but it didn't help. After I was done with my iftaari and namaz, all this comparison was still in my mind. I generally get on my study desk by 11PM but I don't know why and from whom I was taking the revenge - I decided to waste my time. This continued till 1AM and then I went to my study table because I knew that I can't afford to create the backlog cause if I miss one day, I will miss 10 hours of classes and it will take me one week to clear just one day of backlog because it will add up to my everyday classes. I almost cried as soon as I turned my Laptop. I decided to write things in my diary because I was about to breakdown. I picked up my pen but I wasn't able to write anything. I just looked at the blank page for 5-10 mins. I closed my diary, took deep breathes and with eyes full of tears, I looked up at the sky, closed my eyes and prayed to God. After a while everything settled down. I was calm and I realized that this is what I chose for myself. I can't compare myself with others because I have big dreams and I want to accomplish big things in life. The fact that I am not where I want to be, should be enough for me to push myself everyday. My hardwork will never disappoint me. I know for a matter of fact, this thing everyday will not provide me enough motivation, somedays I will be low but when I know why I am doing all this, things will become more doable and a bit easier. Comparison is the thief of joy. But you know what hurts the most ?? - My back 😭 Rabiya

Question: What motivates you to study and why?
Answer: I wasn't studying since four days because I had to complete my court internship diary and submit it in the university. I was busy doing that. I was lying on my bed, awake. I got up suddenly and rushed to my study table. Today, I was just procrastinating without any reason. I was finding reasons to not study. I told myself that I am really tired and I should take a break. I am not doing well, emotionally as well. The tornado that has emerged inside me, I don't know how to settle it down. All I can do is cry and weep for a while and get back to work. I knew I just want to beat this initial resistance and then I would be fine. I knew that once I reach my study table, I would not get up before completing atleast one chapter. And without getting a second thought, I threw my quilt away, sat on the chair, turned the laptop on, opened the book and started studying. Just after 10 minutes, my mom came and she kept her palm on my hand and gently started stroking my hairs. She started reciting some verse from Quran and probably was praying that I pass my exams. I don't know, what hit me but tears rolled down my cheeks. I wanted to hug my mom and cry. But I didn't. Maybe I never would. I just can't. Sometimes we get lost. Lost in the future. Lost in the past. Lost in the people who left. Lost in the people who are to come. I study late till night many atimes. Whenever I don't know what to do in life. When the fear of failure hits me hard that I end up crying my soul out, when the uncertain future to come, scares me to hell, I just go and stand outside my parents room. I just see them. I sit near the door and hear them snoring (haha). It makes me cry. It makes me feel something. It breaks me but also at the same time rebuilds me. I just look at them and get back to studying. Because that's the only way, I can do something from them. I can try to pay back to them. My parents and their dream to see me succeed is enough to beat that initial resistance and start getting some shit done. If not for myself, I do it for them. And that's enough to get me going and I hope it gets you going too. All the best ! Rabiya

Question: How did one experience change your view of life?
Answer: I finished writing my exams this week only. I am on a break for a week, then again grind will begin. So, my sister has a coloring book and once in a while when I am bored I borrow the book from her and fill colours in it. Yesterday, I was coloring this picture. Did you find anything new ? No, right ? Just a ship 🚢 seems sailing in the sea. But, while I was coloring this picture, it made me to look at life with a different perspective. Below are the observations that I made while coloring the picture - Can u see in the picture, the windows lane of the ship. Only windows are colored. While coloring I was confused which color to fill in. I thought it for a while. Then, I decided k I will complete the picture first and then will think of it later. Once I was done coloring the picture, I again started to think of a color which would look good. I was thinking, thinking. But, after sometime I realized that it looks better uncolored. That void space is complementing the whole picture. Even if I add a color, it will seem crowded. This is the case with our life. Sometimes we often ponder upon things, why certain things happened the way it did ? why I did not get what I wanted ? what if I was this and that ? We waste our precious time while looking for answers to this question. But we fail to realize that somethings don't have or even don't need an answer. It's better if they are left the way they are. Constantly putting an effort to such things will take away our mental piece and will not yield anything. If left the way they are, they will definitely add beauty to your life. 2. Value people who care and love you. Can you see the clouds in the picture ? What color is it in the cloud ? Blue right ? Yes, certainly there is a blue color filled in the clouds. But, after filling the blue color, I put white color on it, just to add a gradient and make it look more pretty. But you can't see it ,right ? That's what role our loved ones play in our life. We may not everytime recognize and appreciate there presence but certainly they are there, adding beauty and value to our life. They are the ones who constantly keep us in there prayers and blessings. They would never want anything wrong for us. They will just stay, without you even knowing. So, value them. Appreciate there presence. Tell that you love them. Thank them for there presence. It will definitely make them happy. 3. Some mistakes can't be erased You see the steam coming out of the ship. As I started coloring the clouds, I mistakenly thought that steam is a cloud too. I colored the steam with blue 🤦‍♀️. Then I realized that it's not a cloud. It made me upset for few seconds. So, I thought I will just try to erase the blue. I end up using half eraser to rectify the error. Color did fade away but not too much, it was still visible. While erasing, the page many a times came on the verge of breaking. So, I thought let's just put another color on it. I thought to put brown. But still blue is visible. But how does that matter ? it's okay. ̶M̶i̶s̶k̶a̶t̶e̶s̶, Mistakes are part of you. It doesn't make you any worse. It's not the mistake that matters, it's how you deal with it, what you learn from it and how you apply the lesson in your life. Take chances, make mistakes. That's how we grow. Mistakes are what we often call them experience later. Few years later these mistakes will be your strength, learned lessons and will give you a sense of pride that you made it through. So, it's okay to make mistakes, unless you don't repeat them and you don't learn from them. 4. Broken but beautiful ❤ While coloring the picture, my sister who was also coloring besides me, broke a crayon :( . She - Yaar, I broke a crayon man. I - What difference does that make ? It still colors the same. She - Okay, okay. Don't give me gyaan. I know. I - Huh, whatever. The broken still colors the same. Infact, the edges of it, became more sharper than before, which allowed to color easily at narrow spaces. How beautiful is this ? Broken but beautiful ❤. This is what makes life more beautiful. Somethings at some point of time seems broken to us. But, eventually we realize that the healing process made something very beautiful out of broken. All of your mistakes, worries, failures, define you. They are a part of you. Embrace them. They add meaning to your life. Make them worth your efforts. We do not see things as they are, rather we see things as WE ARE 💞. Our thoughts shape our vision. We see what we choose to see. It's just the matter of perspective.

Question: Who do you miss the most?
Answer: Every cool breeze of air, reminds me of him. Every flower of rose, I can smell him in it. Every song in my playlist, has him in it. Every moment I live by, he is with me always. He gave me forever, in a short period of time. I think when you truly love someone when he is always there in the back of your mind. Like he might not be there in person but you wish he was there with you all the time. Right now I just wish if I could laugh with him, gossip with him, smile with him, hug him, hold him tight, pull his cheeks, run my fingers through his hairs.I honestly wish I could do so many things with him. I just want my dopamine levels to go silly all over again. Isn't it crazy ? You can have so many feelings for one person. You see everything in that one person. Love is a very weird feeling but it's the most amazing feeling in the world. When he texts you ‘ I Love you’ or calls you out of the blue. Your heart pounds and eyes lights up with the joy. It's crazy. It's been more than a year, but still I love him and why will I not ? we were together for four freaking years. Like most amazing years of my life. I wish I could just go back and fix things up. I met him in Mumbai, while I was there to study for medical entrance. One day out of nowhere, we crossed each other at the coaching classes and we started talking. We happened to be from the same city, same area. It felt like I found someone who was a home to me. Staying away from family is something which you can't describe. Somedays you miss them most when you hit the rock-bottom. We were always there to support each other - emotionally, mentally. We saw so many things together. We explored Mumbai and nearby cities -Lonavla, Pune, Nashik, every weekend we had such road trips. We have enjoyed so much. We have so many memories together. Those deep emotional talks at Marine Drive, Shopping at Lokhandwala, Finding hidden cafes at Pali Hill Road, Long walks at Colaba Causeway, we have seen it all together. If I have to write about us, our moments, I can write endlessly without lifting a pen. Friendship turned into Love. But we never changed. We were the same. Two stupid, idiots working their ass off on weekdays and having literal shit fun on weekends. First relationship, first boyfriend, I was his girlfriend, he was my love, he is still my love. Everything was going well. We appeared for entrance. I bagged a seat in a government medical college but the field I got didn't interest me. He never wanted to be an engineer, but did it for the sake of his parents. We came back to our city. I took admission in Law School and he went to New York for his studies. Who the kucf says long distance doesn't work ? It does work for sure. With right person everything works. You know what's the most beautiful feeling in the world ? To be loved by the same person so intensely and purely whom you love the most. It's the most beautiful feeling in the world. Last year, he came back from New York due to Covid. I saw him after almost a year. That hug at the airport, still gives me chills at the bone, everytime I remember it. We were together again. My favorite picture of us together ❤. Our relationship was as beautifull as a movie. We have sweetest of lifetime memories. We have done everything together, watching a stupid flop movie to prepping for exams, we have seen it all. I still wear that ring he gave me with our initials carved together. He still wears the hoodies and jackets that I gave him. I saw him yesterday only,wearing black hood that I gave him. He still has our picture as his wallpaper. It's our childish ego that is keeping us separate. We both are still stuck at the same page. We haven't moved on. One day I asked him, how much he loves me ? He sent me this - He is the most cutest and most sweet person, I have come across. I was very lucky to have him. I took him for granted. I messed up our magical love story. Aasan hai kya aisi mohabbat karna, jiske badle mohabbat na mile ? Is it easy to love someone unconditionally, when you know you will never get the same in return ? Is that love easy ? It's very weird feeling you know. To love someone whom you never saw, you never met, you never spent a second with, you never known each other, you don't even know if he even exist ? To know what love is, when you never had one. To know what a relationship feels like when you were never into one. To know what heartbreak is, when you never gave your heart to anyone. It's weird and stupid sometimes. Question: What were some of the unforgettable incidents from your school life?
Answer: It was 3rd of August 2012, just a day before my birthday. I was very excited, as soon as I came back from school, hastily had lunch, took some money from my dad and ran towards a shop to buy chocolates for my birthday. In my head, right now I am standing on that shop. The conversation with the shopkeeper went like this - He - Beta, you study at Saint Chavara, right ? I - Yes uncle. He - Do you know Prajakta ? I - Yes, she is my senior at school. But why are you asking me this ? He - She is no more. She met with an accident while returning from school. The rickshaw driver is also dead. I - No I don't know who is Prajakta ? And I don't study in Saint Chavara. I couldn't believe what my ears heard. I don't know what happened to me at that moment ? Prajakta, she was the only sister of my classmate, Kartik. She often used to visit our class. She was the head girl of the school. I saw her in the morning assembly only. How can she die ? Kartik, what happened to him ? How will he react ? Her beautiful face (and when I say beautiful she was damn beautiful), her loving nature, the way she used to arrange kids for assembly, her voice while singing the chorus, everything was revolving around me while I was returning home. After I reached home, I started crying. I don't know why ? She was just a senior. Just interacted with her few times. Just saw her from distant always. Never shared a bond with her. But I could feel her absence. When we are around few people, even though we don't interact with each other, they subconsciously become a part of our life. We may not see them everyday, we may not even know them properly but somewhere we get habitual to their presence. At night I received a call from a classmate. She told me that - Kartik needs to be operated coz he is injured so bad, their school auto was hit by a huge truck and he, his sister and driver, this 3 people were only present in the auto at the time of the accident. Kartik somehow survived the hit but the other two died on the spot. My classmate also told me that on that particular day, Prajakta asked her parents to let her and Kartik go by scooty to school, but parents denied. Now, the only regret their parents has is - they wish they would have allowed her to go by scooty that day. May be she would have been said. But it is said that no one escape death. While I am writing this I still can't believe that Prajakta is no more. Her beautiful face is infront of my eyes right now. How life is uncertain, you know ? Whenever I remember this incident, I think she must have also planned for her future. What about her dreams, the things she wanted to do, the places she wanted to visit, her ambitions, everything died with her. A huge filter was donated by her parents to the school which read as - In The Loving Memory Of Prajakta. Whenever Kartik drops message in the school group, it always reminds me of Prajakta. I was never close to her, but still I remember her very often. I wonder how her family must be coping up with their loss. We come across lot of people in our lives but few people become a strong part of our memory. Rabiya 💫

Question: Are you happy?
Answer: Growing up I always wanted to be independent, take charge, and be tomboyish bcoz being independent was so deeply connected with being a man. I played cricket, learned to drive, wore shirts, and did everything that a "guy" can do, all in a vague attempt just to prove to people that women and men are no different. Question: What is love?
Answer: Yesterday I took my mom to hospital. She is been not keeping well these days. Not the covid thing. The hospital is a bit from my place and finding an auto or uber while coming back is a task. So, we went with our own vehicle. Doctor checked her and prescribed some tests. The laboratory was some 1KM away from the hospital. We went there too. I parked my scooty in the basement of the building and got done with the tests. I brought the scooty from the basement and felt that something is wrong with it. Maybe it's nothing. May be due to inclination of basement parking, I might be feeling it. I told my mom to sit and as I started driving, scooty tilted left and right. There, it was a puncture. I parked my scooty on the service road and dropped my mom to the hospital in the auto. I told her to wait there because getting a puncture repaired in an unknown place is a task. I will have to figure out the shop nearby and stuff. I came back on the same street where I parked my scooty and searched for a puncture repair shop. I took me ten minutes to get it there. It was a shabby looking little shop. Tiny. I asked the guy to check. He checked it and told me that the tube of the tire is holed and it needs to be replaced. He didn't had one. So he went to purchase. Now it was already around 30minutes since I left my mom at the hospital. The sky was getting darker and so was my mom getting tensed about me. Finally after 70–80 minutes that guy handed me my scooty and I drove back to the hospital. As expected there was my mom, sorrounded by 2–3 nurses, standing outside, crying and sobbing. As soon as she saw me, she came running to me. First I started laughing telling my mom that what's there to cry in it. Honestly, I also became a bit emotional and my eyes got filled with tears. Nurses started telling me - ‘Where were you ? Your mom is crying since an hour.’ I thanked the nurses and left. While driving I asked my mom - Why she started crying in the first place ? She started telling me - I saw in crime patrol one day. Just like you, one girl goes to repair the puncture and then she gets gang raped. You know how much I was worried. I prayed to God that - If you wish please take me but give me back my Rabiya. It left me speechless. What can I even say beyond that. As soon as we got back home, I hugged my mom tight and assured her that I am strong and I would never let anyone do that to me. Though she was barely convinced. What is love ? I don't know, actually. If this is not what love is, I don't know what it is. How intense is the war of feelings that do not fit the boundaries of words. Rabiya

Question: What is something everyone should know?
Answer: At whatever stage of life you are at right now, don't just let it go. Don't treat it like a fleeting phase. Or if you are in college don't waste it wishing to be already graduated and having a job and making money. If you are single don't waste it wishing to be in love with someone. If you are old don't waste it wishing to be dead already 😜 Everything you wish for will come in due time. Things will reach out to you when they are good for you. Just wait and let things happen. There is no point in wishing about something which you will eventually get in future. There is nothing like looking back and feeling sad about those years because you were missing out on something which you already had in pursuit of hoping for something better. Ofcourse it's important to make goals and reach them at earliest, but in the process don't neglect the present because this things you have right now you won't get it again. We often ponder upon things and wish that a certain thing should happen to us right now, everything will come to you when you are ready for it. Eventually every part of your puzzle will fall in place to create a wonderful masterpiece. Just embrace the place you are at right now, it's lovely to be here and journey ahead is beautiful as well but just don't miss on stars while waiting for the moon ✨. Rabiya 💫

Question: What made you upset today?
Answer: Seriously Bombay High Court ? In a recent ruling by the Nagpur bench of the Bombay High Court, it was observed that there should be "skin-to-skin contact with sexual intent" in order to be considered as sexual assault. The ruling also said that 'mere groping' will not fall under sexual assault. The High Court further ruled that mere touching the chest of the minor will not amount to sexual assault unless the accused removes clothes of the victim or slid hands inside the garments, making it a physical contact. The sexual assault under the POCSO Act involves committing assault with sexual intent and getting physical without penetration by touching the private parts of the child or making the child touch the private organs of the accused, noted the judge in the court hearing. "The act of pressing the breast of a child aged 12 years, in the absence of any specific detail as to whether the top was removed or whether he inserted his hand inside her top and pressed her breast, would not fall under the definition of ‘sexual assault'," the judge held, adding, "it would certainly fall within the definition of section 354 of the IPC, which penalises outraging the modesty of a woman." Ironically today 24th Jan is celebrated as National Girl Child Day in India. Edit - I know that the man was punished under s.354 IPC under the offense of outraging the modesty of women. Here the court specifically stated that skin to skin contact is necessary for the offence od sexual assault under POSCO. This statement of the court doesn't make sense. Just because there is a barrier of a cloth that doesn't mean that it isn't a physical contact. Edit 2 - (27–1–20) - Supreme court has now put this order on stay and also notices has been issued to the accused and the Maharashtra government. Now, Supreme court will look into the matter. Source- Groping 'Without Skin-To-Skin Contact' Does Not Qualify As Sexual Assault: Bombay HC

Question: What is one piece of simple advice that actually changed your life?
Answer: Main tere baare mai kya sochti hun, Tu mere baare mai kya sochti hai, kya farak padta hai yaar ? Jab tak saath hai tab tak rehte hai aise hee. Ek din toh alag ho hee jayenge. (What I think of you, what you think of me, how does that matter ? Let's live the way we are right now, until we are together. One day we will not be together anymore) So, I have 2 best friends. We are group of three best friends. I met them at university and day by day our friendship grew stronger. We are together always. Our seniors, juniors and even professors know that we are best friends. So, few months back, we were talking some random shit. One of my friend said - Yaar, we will go on our honeymoon together. It will be exciting. Yaar, our babies will be very cute na ? To which I replied - Bro, see realistic dreams na. No matter, how much we are best friends and no matter how so many promises we make to each other that we will stay together, one day this friendship of ours will be lost eventually. We will just look at each other's stories and like each other's post. That's it. To which my other friend replied - Rabiya, actually what you said is truth. Main tere baare mai kya sochti hun, Tu mere baare mai kya sochti hai, kya farak padta hai yaar ? Jab tak saath hai tab tak rehte hai aise hee. Ek din toh alag ho hee jayenge. (What I think of you, what you think of me, how does that matter ? Let's live the way we are right now, until we are together. One day we will not be together anymore) How true is this ? No matter howsoever bestfriends we make, at the end it's you and your family. Who are we fooling ? It's beautiful to make lifelong bonds but as the time passes, as we move out of college, we make our own career, we settle down in our life and make our own family. Friendships looses it's flavors bcoz we get so interwined in our own life, everyone does. This conversation remained in my mind for many days and I changed a lot after this. Like you know we unknowingly start expecting things, start dreaming about things, but eventually things change. We move on and relationship or friendships are left behind. Why to burden any kind of relationship with any sort of expectations ? Just live how you are, just stay happy in the present moment, and enjoy it without thinking about future. Now, I don't expect anything from anyone, and I am writing this is in my full senses. It's weird to not expect but once you know, once you learn how to not get attached, you eventually understand and often it makes you happy bcoz you do things without expecting them in return. The way I see people in my life is very different now. I have found new insight in my life. I have changed alot in behavior wise, emotions wise. Why to place your happiness in the fragile hands of others ? This way life is more beautiful, more happy and cheerful. No expectations, no disappointments. This is us.
